caption: The cord of a window blind is pulled, and the blind gathers upward as the cord runs down.

sa.check: A window blind hangs with its cord.
The pull comes first and the rise follows.

pc.expect: The blind rises only as fast as the cord is pulled and stops when the pulling stops.
pc.fail: It rises with no pull; or keeps rising after the pull stops; or the cord is pulled and the blind stays.

pc.expect: The cord stays taut on the pulled side and does not stretch.
pc.fail: It is slack while lifting; or stretches; or bunches.

pc.expect: The blind hangs from the head rail and the slats gather at the top.
pc.fail: They gather at the bottom; or the blind rises above the rail; or it floats.

pc.expect: The cord goes down as the blind goes up.
pc.fail: Both go up; or the cord is still while the blind moves; or the blind goes down as the cord is pulled.

pc.expect: One blind and one cord keep their number.
pc.fail: The blind duplicates; or the cord vanishes; or the blind turns into another object.

pc.expect: The blind and the window stay the same.
pc.fail: The blind changes colour; or the window changes; or the room rearranges.
